name: Regenx Tech Corp.
summary: Regenx Tech Corp. primarily focuses on two main areas: exploring and advancing mineral properties, and creating and deploying innovative extraction technologies across Spain and North America. The company holds an option to acquire a stake in the Aroche Wollastonite Project, a site located in the Huelva province of southwestern Spain, which comprises five mining concessions spanning approximately 150 hectares. In addition to its property ventures, Regenx Tech has developed several proprietary technologies. These include the HM X-mill, a mineral grinding mill engineered for crushing raw ores and reprocessing both concentrates and tailings; the HM X-leach, a novel, cyanide-free method for extracting gold and other precious metals; and the HM X-tract, a versatile, self-contained mobile processing unit. The HM X-tract integrates modules for crushing, grinding, sizing, gravity separation, flotation, concentration, clarification, water recycling, power generation, and comprehensive operational service support. Established in 2017, the company initially operated as Mineworx Technologies Ltd. before officially changing its name to Regenx Tech Corp. in October 2022. Its corporate base is located in St. Albert, Canada.
